INTRODUCTION
Zyro Dynamics has documented this Onboarding and Separation Policy to ensure that both the joining
experience and the exit process are handled in a structured, professional, and compassionate manner. The
Company believes that the quality of a new employee's first 90 days has a lasting impact on their performance
and engagement. Equally, a well-managed separation reflects the Company's respect for the individual and
supports a smooth transition for the team that remains.

Probation Period
All new employees, with the exception of those joining at grade L7 and above, are subject to a probation period of
6 months starting from their date of joining. A formal probation review is conducted at the end of Month 3 and
Month 6. Successful completion of probation is confirmed in writing by HR. Benefits including ESOP eligibility and
full leave accrual commence from the date probation is confirmed.
 Note: The probation period may be extended by up to 3 months if performance has not met the expected standard during
the initial period. This will be communicated in writing to the employee.
PART B — VOLUNTARY SEPARATION / RESIGNATION
An employee may terminate their employment with the Company by giving written notice to their reporting
manager and HR as per the notice period applicable to their grade. Notice must be submitted through the
ZyroHR portal and confirmed by HR in writing.

Employees are not entitled to avail or adjust accrued leave during the notice period unless specifically approved
by the reporting manager and HR. Where both parties agree to shorten the notice period, the salary paid will
correspond to the actual notice period served. Where a mutual agreement has not been reached and the
employee does not complete the full notice period, the Company will recover a sum equivalent to the salary for
the shortfall period.
PART C — INVOLUNTARY SEPARATION
The Company may terminate an employee's services in the following circumstances:
  Failure to meet performance standards over a sustained period, including unsuccessful completion of a
Performance Improvement Plan.
 Gross or wilful misconduct, serious violation of any company policy, or unethical conduct as determined
through the disciplinary process.
 Redundancy or restructuring, where the role is eliminated as a result of organisational changes.
An employee whose employment is terminated on the grounds of wilful misconduct or unethical conduct will not
be entitled to any payment in lieu of notice. The Company will follow applicable Indian labour law provisions for all
cases of involuntary separation.
PART D — RETIREMENT
The normal retirement age for all employees of Zyro Dynamics shall be 58 years. The date of birth recorded with
the Company at the time of employment shall be treated as the sole valid evidence of age for all matters
pertaining to service and retirement. Any additional age proof submitted at the time of retirement will not be
considered.

Full and Final Settlement
Full and Final Settlement is processed within 30 days of the employee's last working day and includes:
outstanding salary for days worked in the final month; encashment of remaining Earned Leave balance; pro-rated
performance bonus where applicable; Gratuity for employees with 5 or more years of continuous service; and
processing of vested ESOP shares. Any outstanding dues owed to the Company will be recovered from the F&F;
amount.
